overall_reason: The words and screenshots belong to a real product (Mom/Dad thread isolation, port numbers, Telegram bot, /fast and /deep, Gatekeeper step), but they sit on the default dark-cyan landing kit: pill badge, two-tone centred hero, numbered steps, an 18-card icon-tile grid under 'Everything you need. Nothing you don't.', FAQ accordion.

findings.where: 'Everything you need. Nothing you don't.' feature grid, 1440 tiles 02-05
findings.evidence: Eighteen equal 3-up cards, each a teal icon tile + title + 1-3 lines, from 'Global Hotkey Overlay' to 'Guided Family Setup'. Failed T-DELETION on the icons (keyboard, users, lock, server, mic, file...) and the section runs 4+ screens at the same rhythm; strong items ('What Mom asks stays Mom's', 'Says What It Is Doing') are buried at the same weight as 'Markdown & LaTeX'.
findings.before: 18 identical icon cards under a stock head
findings.after: Lead with the 3-4 features only KinAI has (per-member privacy, Telegram family bot, two model slots, backend auto-detect) as large rows with their screenshots; collapse the rest into a plain list.
findings.why: A long uniform feature wall is the default agent output and flattens the product's real differentiators.

findings.evidence: Failed T-MIRROR: pill badge with bolt icon 'Now with a guided family setup' above a centred two-tone h1 'Share your local AI / with your family.' with the second line in the accent cyan, glowing pill CTA + ghost second CTA, on a near-black page with a radial teal wash. This is the stock dark AI-product hero; a neighbouring local-LLM app would get the same.
findings.before: Pill + two-tone centred head + glow CTA pair
findings.after: Open on the product: the 'What Mom asks stays Mom's' welcome screenshot is the strongest image; put it beside a plain head instead of below the fold in a frame.
findings.why: The hero's structure says 'AI startup template' before the copy says 'family'.

findings.evidence: T-FRESH-READER: 'How it works', 'Everything you need. Nothing you don't.', 'Common questions' fit any site; 'Plays nice with your setup' is the stock integrations head.
findings.after: A head that carries a fact, e.g. 'One Mac hosts. Everyone else joins with a code.'
findings.why: Category-label and stock-cadence heads add length without information.

findings.evidence: T-STOCK-ORDER: mock-product hero -> numbered steps -> equal feature cards -> integrations list -> three equal platform cards (pricing-tier shape) -> FAQ accordion -> roadmap -> footer: 6 stock sections in stock order. Below the 7 threshold because the install guide tabs and roadmap are product-specific.
findings.after: Merge 'How it works' into the install guide (they repeat the same host/client facts) and cut one band.
findings.why: The skeleton is default even where the content is not.

findings.evidence: Failed T-THREE-LINE: '100% private', 'Seamlessly finds Ollama...', 'Beautiful streaming markdown formatting', 'free forever' are unfalsifiable stock claims sitting next to concrete ones ('Per-peer isolation in the host's database').
findings.after: "No cloud, no accounts. Chats stay in a database on your Mac, isolated per family member."
findings.why: Stock reassurance dilutes the specific privacy mechanism the product actually has.

strengths: Copy is concrete and only-this-product in many places: 'Per-peer isolation in the host's database — Mom doesn't see Dad's threads', ports 11434/1234/8000, 'Right-click KinAI in Applications → Open / Required the first time to bypass Gatekeeper', '/fast or /deep'.
Real product screenshots in the carousel and the integrations panel instead of an invented dashboard mock.
Honest limits stated up front: 'macOS-only for now', 'Cannot host models directly yet'.
disputed sweep hit: chrome_glyphs on 'v0.2.147' / 'v0.3-v0.5' reads as a real release number and a real roadmap, not fake versions.
not_investigated: Carousel slides beyond the first (only the active slide is visible in the tiles).
